verdict.rationale: Zapier's docs say developers can embed its automation directly into their own product so users connect apps and run automations 'under your brand' without leaving the app. The Workflow API is pitched as powering a built-in automation experience or integration marketplace across 9,000+ integrations. The evidence is marketing-level summaries only. Missing for 10: in-depth embedding docs showing how white-labeling works (branding removal, custom UI/domain, per-customer account handling), details of the embed mechanics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
